_readme: Master data for recurring parties. Vendors are matched by VAT Reg. TIN (digits only, first 9 digits); the master vendor_address is the exact printed header address and replaces whatever OCR/LLM produced. Customers are matched by TIN or name key; address_variants are the exact address spellings printed on each invoice layout and are used to repair OCR typos and vendor/customer address bleed. Add new lines here - no code change needed.
